title: A Call for Control of Frontier AI Models
summary: International call launched on 21 September 2026 by Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre alongside 20 other world leaders and the European Commission on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. Urges mandatory pre-deployment safety testing, independent third-party evaluations, incident reporting, and exploring a UN-style international oversight institution for frontier AI.
